description: This file defines the Encounter class in the openmrs-core project, representing a patient's visit or interaction with healthcare providers, along with related properties, methods for handling observations, orders, diagnoses, providers, and other encounter details.

classes.name: Encounter
classes.description: Represents a patient's visit or interaction in the healthcare system, including observations, diagnoses, orders, and provider information.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Returns the set of non-voided, leaf observations associated with this encounter, including handling hierarchical obs structures.

methods.name: addObs
methods.description: Adds an Obs object to this encounter, propagating relevant encounter attributes to the observation and its group members.

methods.name: copyAndAssignToAnotherPatient
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current encounter, assigns it to a different patient, and duplicates associated observations and provider details.
